note: Published transliterations of the Voynich Manuscript, all from Rene Zandbergen's voynich.nu. The checksums are of the copies bundled with this release; 'tvtt fetch' verifies a download against them and warns, rather than fails, when the upstream file has been revised.
licence: The transliteration files are made freely available by their authors for research use.

zl.title: Zandbergen-Landini (ZL)
zl.description: The most complete EVA transliteration: all 5374 loci, extended EVA glyphs, regularly corrected. The recommended default.

v101.title: v101 (Glen Claston), IVTFF form
v101.description: The v101 alphabet, which distinguishes far more glyph shapes than EVA. This is the IVTFF conversion, so it carries locus and page metadata.

v101_native.title: v101 (original layout)
v101_native.description: The original, unmodified v101 file with high-ASCII bytes and its own locus ordering. Kept for compatibility with older work.

takahashi.title: Takahashi (H), interlinear form
takahashi.description: Takeshi Takahashi's transliteration as it appears in Jorge Stolfi's 1999 interlinear file. Basic lowercase EVA.

voynichese.title: Takahashi (voynichese.com edition)
voynichese.description: The Takahashi text as served by voynichese.com. Differs from the interlinear edition only in how unreadable characters are marked.

currier.title: Currier / D'Imperio (C)
currier.description: The original Currier transliteration in the Currier alphabet. Covers about half the manuscript, and is the source of the Currier A/B distinction.

fsg.title: FSG (Friedman First Study Group)
fsg.description: The oldest machine-readable transliteration, in the FSG alphabet, from William Friedman's study group.

reference.title: Reference transliteration (RF, extended)
reference.description: An automatic merge of the GC and ZL transliterations, expressed in extended EVA. Useful as a tie-breaker when two transcribers disagree.

reference_basic.title: Reference transliteration (RF, basic)
reference_basic.description: The same reference transliteration reduced to basic EVA, with no extended glyphs.
